rationale: Canonical MNB hub for all supervisory soft-law instrument types; single crawl entry point for the A3 family.
Numbered MNB recommendations register with explicit effective dates — core deadline-bearing stream for banks and PSPs.
Executive circulars register produces its own early, short-deadline supervisory signals; distinct from the recommendations list.
Supervisory news feed is the lowest-latency change-detection surface for new instruments and consultations.
Publisher-provided machine-readable RSS feeds — cheapest robust ingestion channel for MNB output.
ASZP decree register legally fixes supervisory reporting obligations and submission deadlines; separate subdomain.
Draft reporting decrees give 3-9 month forward warning of new obligations and entry-into-force dates.
Per-year credit-institution reporting packages plus ad-hoc requests with explicit deadlines; recurring output.
Searchable enforcement/licensing decision database — continuously produced ground truth on supervisory priorities.
Annual examination plan and report is a recurring publication predicting where supervisory attention lands.
MNB payments-authority inspection page carries priority examination criteria for PSPs — payments core of the cell.
IT/ICT supervisory expectations section directly governs payments-technology and infrastructure choices.
Static legislation index under the same szabalyozas parent; useful mapping but adds little standalone signal.
Separate green-finance subdomain closes a coverage hole, but URL verification failed — recheck liveness before tracking.
EN mirror of the HU instrument hub with partial coverage; monitor the Hungarian parent instead.
CRD IV supervisory disclosure tables update on a fixed EBA cadence and give structured HU prudential options.
Payments section/annual Payment Systems Report pre-announces regulatory intent on instant payments and fraud.
Licensing-side guidance page duplicates the recommendations register; valuable for PI entrants but a sibling section.
Static PSZAF-era archive — mine once for baselines and withdrawal history, not a continuous signal source.
Single consolidated decree text on NJT; evidence for one instrument, monitor the NJT database itself instead.
Resolution-authority regulation section is a low-volume MNB sub-stream, marginal for payments/ATM-POS scope.
Broad Big-4 insights hub, mostly off-scope with unclear reuse terms; secondary commentary only, never primary record.
Official gazette is the authoritative promulgation point driving every Hungarian entry-into-force date.
State consolidated law database with point-in-time status — the backbone of a compliance deadline calendar.
Explanatory-memoranda search gives legislative intent and EU-directive linkage behind transition periods.
Hpt. consolidated page: amendment stream is the highest-yield statutory tracker for Hungarian banking obligations.
Pft. is the PSD2 transposition vehicle and PSD3 anchor; jogtar reuse terms unclear but NJT mirror available.
